description: This file defines the interface and data structures for the CCSP CWMP Management Parameter Access Object. It includes function pointer typedefs for API methods related to setting and getting parameter values, attributes, and managing objects, as well as interface identifiers and constants.

classes.name: CCSP_CWMP_MPA_INTERFACE
classes.description: Interface structure defining the management parameter access object with function pointers for operations such as setting/getting values, attributes, and object management.

methods.name: LockWriteAccess
methods.description: Function pointer for locking write access to the management parameter interface.

methods.name: UnlockWriteAccess
methods.description: Function pointer for unlocking write access to the management parameter interface.

methods.name: SetParameterValues
methods.description: Function pointer for setting parameter values.

methods.name: SetParameterValuesWithWriteID
methods.description: Function pointer for setting parameter values with an associated write ID.

methods.name: GetParameterValues
methods.description: Function pointer for retrieving parameter values.

methods.name: GetParameterNames
methods.description: Function pointer for retrieving parameter names.

methods.name: SetParameterAttributes
methods.description: Function pointer for setting parameter attributes.

methods.name: GetParameterAttributes
methods.description: Function pointer for retrieving parameter attributes.

methods.name: AddObject
methods.description: Function pointer for adding a new object.

methods.name: DeleteObject
methods.description: Function pointer for deleting an existing object.
